reason: The best update-700 checkpoint failed both the preregistered fit-capacity and held-out-source gates. All-saved fit aggregate was 0.2052 with Marmousi 0.2794; calibration was 1.5039 and confirmation was 2.2006.
diagnosis: Adding a few sources within each anchor medium improves fit records but does not produce source interpolation. The very large errors for layered sources with small spatial displacement but large onset/frequency changes point to missing analytic source-time conditioning, not insufficient update count.
rollback: Do not add more media, more source records, or more updates to this mapper. Test one analytic source-onset phase variable, t-(travel+t0), under train-only source-holdout evidence before any broader architecture work.
